ns2:section.sectionText: Familiarize graduate students with current practices in bridge design and to provide them with the background to understand the American Associate of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) code. The course will cover topics related the use of AASHTO to define live loads on bridges and design bridge superstructure and substructure. The course will address specifically highway bridge types constructed using reinforced concrete (RC), prestressed concrete (PC), and steel. In addition, the course will get the students familiar with the stat-of-art methodologies adopted for bridge retrofitting.
